method: Replay identical limited player knowledge; no real game actions. Existing billing/reservation path with separate capped local ledger. No automatic retries. One shortlist alternative reordered equivalent seats; normalized to an existing legal choice before comparison.
limitations: Single saved position, small sample; not a reliability benchmark.
Two-stage 8192 comparison also adds an explicit tie rule, so it is not an isolated test of staging.
Successful comparison publicReason exposed likely Merlin; full public speech pipeline was not exercised.
An assessment is not a completed game decision.
